title: Figure 5.6: Scale schematic of Fusion Ship II, a 750-MWe IEC fusion spacecraft
description: Black-and-white engineering schematic captioned 'Figure 5.6. Scale Schematic of Fusion Ship II, a 750-MWe IEC Fusion Spacecraft', with a 'Top View' showing dimensions (300 m, 175 m), crew area, argon tanks and 'IEC Reactor (10 total)', and a 'Back view' labeling DECs and ion thrusters. Surrounding text gives mass budgets, a 220 km/s delta-V Jupiter round trip, and comparison with a spherical Tokamak concept.
